reasoning: Two disjoint cliques of size 5 use exactly 10 vertices. With 13 vertices total, three vertices would remain unassigned, violating the requirement that every vertex belong to one of the cliques. Hence no such graph exists.
cot_trace: We need 13 vertices, two vertex-disjoint cliques each size 5, that uses 10 vertices, but we have 13 vertices total, each vertex must belong to one of these cliques. That's impossible because 2*5=10 vertices, leaving 3 vertices unassigned, but requirement says every vertex must belong to one of these cliques. So UNSAT.
